    • Method Detail

      • privateData

        protected final Data privateData​(User.Type user)
        Fetch private data related to the provided user.

        If there is no data associated with this user, this method returns an empty data object.

        Parameters:
        user - the target user
        Returns:
        the private data related to the provided user

      • privateData

        protected final void privateData​(User.Type user,
                                 Data data)
        Sets or removes private data related to the provided user. If the provided data is null then the private data is removed entirely. The input data must be a map object.
        Parameters:
        user - the target user
        data - the private data related to the provided user as a map object, or null to remove the related data

      • supports

        public abstract boolean supports​(java.lang.String user)
        Returns true if this provider supports authenticating the specified user login.

        This method should be a quick indication and not an extensive check, so it may happen that this method returns true inadvertently.

        Parameters:
        user - the user login
        Returns:
        true if this provider supports authenticating the specified user login

      • authenticate

        public abstract User.Type authenticate​(Data context)
        Authenticates a user based on the provided opaque credentials.
        Parameters:

        Returns:
        the matching user instance or null if no user matches

      • join

        public abstract User.Type join​(Data context,
                               User.Type existing)
        Enable this provider for the specified existing user. The user may be null in which case a new user should be created. It is a good idea to synchronize this method to avoid side effects.
        Parameters:
        context - the authentication credentials
        existing - the existing user to bind or null in case of a new user
        Returns:
        null in case the operation failed, or the user (existing or new one) in case of success

      • leave

        public abstract void leave​(User.Type user)
        Disables this provider for the specified user. This method should clear all data as if the user never joined this provider. If the user is null or not joined, then ignore it. It is a good idea to synchronize this method to avoid side effects.
        Parameters:
        user - the user to unbind

      • check

        public boolean check​(Rule.Type rule,
                     User.Type user,
                     Data context)
        Checks if the user passes the specified rule.

        This method may be called by a specific Rule that wants the explicit decision from the providers (i.e. Rule.AskProviders).

        Parameters:
        rule - the rule to evaluate, must not be null
        user - the user, must not be null
        context - the context data to check against matching policies, may be null
        Returns:
        true if the user is explicitly denied

      • snapshot

        public Data snapshot()
        Description copied from class: Entity
        The default entity snapshot implementation includes the required metadata fields to be used by the Template to restore it. It also includes all declared Entity.parameters() and all declared Entity.relationships().

        If this behavior is sufficient, you do not need to override this method. If there is additionnal data to be included in (or removed from) the output, then you should override this method, call the super.snapshot() and work on the returned data.

        You may provide your own custom implementation although it may introduce inconsistencies with the rest of the system.

        In order to safeguard the potentially private or confidential data returned by this method out of necessity, a check on the caller is performed to allow only the current Snapshot implementation.

        Specified by:
        snapshot in interface Snapshotable
        Overrides:
        snapshot in class Entity
        Returns:
        a snapshot data representation of this class instance
